beats.summary: Michael introduces the master bedroom and discusses plans to upgrade it.

evidence.snippet: Michael: This, my friends, is the master bedroom. Check out the cathedral ceilings.
I am going to totally pimp this place out. I am going to put a surround sound system. I am going to put a plasma screen right against this wall.

beats.summary: Dwight warns Michael about the shared wall and potential damage from neighbors.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: No, no, no, no, no. This is a shared wall. Neighbor throws his wife into the wall, plasma screen hits the floor. Totally smashed.
Dwight: Warrantees don't cover it, plus they're a rip-off.

beats.summary: Jim and Pam discuss the Office Olympics and the game Flonkerton.

evidence.snippet: Jim (sings Olympic theme song): This scented candle …andle …andle.
Pam: Jim, they refer to it as Flonkerton.

beats.summary: Jim encourages Phyllis to participate in Flonkerton, and she agrees.

evidence.snippet: Jim: Yes! Phyllis! Phyllis, just put your foot right through here . Right through the flonk.
Phyllis: I'll do it.

beats.summary: Michael discusses mortgage options and the possibility of renting out a room.

evidence.snippet: Michael: No, no, no.
Carol: Is this a financial thing? If it's a financial thing, what some people do is they rent out the third bedroom.

beats.summary: Michael signs a mortgage and expresses satisfaction with his decision.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I made the right decision. I'm glad I signed. I'm a homeowner.
This is good. This is fun. We're having fun.

beats.summary: Dwight makes a joke about buying a coffin with thicker walls.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: A thirty year mortgage at Michael's age essentially means that he's buying a coffin. If I were buying my coffin, I would get one with thicker walls so you couldn't hear the other dead people.

beats.summary: Jim and Pam continue the Office Olympics with Flonkerton, and Kevin wins a medal.

evidence.snippet: Jim: So, who will be challenging Kevin in Flonkerton? Anyone?

beats.summary: Michael offers Dwight the room in his house as a reward for his help.

evidence.snippet: Michael: There's something else Dwight wanted to talk to you about. I have a surprise for you, for helping me out today.

beats.summary: Dwight discusses where to put his terrarium and his grandparents' armoires.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Question. Where can I put my terrarium?
Dwight: Question. My grandparents left me a large number of armoires.
